_: Decision point catalog (METHOD.md D-*). Questions, options and rubrics only; thresholds are constants in decide.py.

outlier_explanation.question: What best explains why this session is an outlier on the named metric?

options.subagent_fanout: most of the cost is in subagents
options.long_session: many human turns, steady cost per turn
options.agent_loop: many API calls per human turn, or many retries or errors
options.heavy_context: high cost per call, dominated by cache reads or input tokens
options.cache_churn: cache writes are a large share of cost
options.verbose_output: output tokens are a large share of cost
options.expensive_model: most cost on a high-priced model for routine work
options.normal: value in line with the session's size; no specific cause

recommendation.question: Does this usage data support suggesting this change to the users of this harness: {candidate}?

options.yes: the data shows the cost the change targets is a meaningful share

recommendation._candidates: analyze/metrics.json recommendations (single source of truth; decide dedups by id <rec id>/<harness>)

commit_link.question: Were these commits produced with the help of this agent session?

options.yes: commits land during or right after the session, in its project, sized like its edits

intent.question: What was the user's intent in this session?
intent._: Reserved. Needs prompt text, which v002 events never carry; listing it in decide.points is an error.
